source: REAL realized MLB WAR: prospects.db career_war (per-season bWAR) joined to data/debuts.json debut years. No synthesized outcomes.
control_note: No true MLB service-time field exists; 'control seasons' is the debut+0..+6 proxy (existing efv_dataset convention). Windows with debut_year > 2019 are not fully resolved through 2025 (window_resolved=false) and may undercount stars.
small_class_caveat: The star-positive class is small (~1e2); usable as a label SOURCE / view, not yet a trained model.
